name: Calibrate verified span credit with exact two-action returns conditional on the preceding skill
pilot: Fit one pilot using only conv-26 and conv-30, the first two complete training histories with all four measured paths in sessions 5-8. Fit its source-credit direction using only the same two histories in sessions 1-4. Evaluate the pilot on the remaining four training histories. Distinguish windows with any already published path at numerical freeze from strictly subsequent windows. Pilot outcomes do not select or modify the main rule.
main: Once all 12 four-path training windows for sessions 5-8 exist, cross-fit six actors. For target d remove d from both the rule-2 training data for sessions 1-4 and the four-path calibration for sessions 5-8. Also freeze one all-six actor for independent development. Evaluate the cross-fits on the existing randomized sessions 9+ panel. Exclude any window with a published path score before numerical freeze from the primary prospective estimate; publish all windows separately. Never use sessions 9+ to fit.
model: Retain the pre-existing mean-native-probability-matched, three-source-feature rule-2 direction. Choose one strength from [0,.25,.5,1,2] at each of three pre-action contexts: initial, after temporal, after activity. Evaluate all 125 schedules by exact two-step expected question F1 on complete real trajectory tables, minus 0.02 times expected path KL in nats from native. Weight questions equally within each calibration dialogue, then dialogues equally. Maximize this objective; ties within 1e-12 choose smallest total strength then lexicographic schedule. This calibrates verified credit; an unverified four-path difference does not become a selection label.
controls: Optimize a single shared strength with the identical reward and KL penalty. Also compare to fixed maximum strength 2, native, terminal, both fixed skills, exchanging the two continuation strengths, and a source-independent control with one logit offset per prefix. Match that control's mean activity probability to the conditional actor across calibration windows separately at each of the three states, weighting windows equally. Retain the original frozen mixture as a benchmark.
attribution: On complete tables decompose the exact change from native into root probability change times native continuation advantage, plus each conditional probability change times its within-prefix advantage and candidate reach. Check that the three contributions sum to the exact return difference for every question. On the randomized panel estimate the focal return and two-step Horvitz-Thompson return using the original blocked physical assignments and a per-path inclusion probability of 1/2.
decision: Use only the main cross-fitted strictly prospective panel for promotion. Require at least 4 histories with positive focal gain over the matched rate-only control, gains >=.02 against native and terminal focal F1, positive versus shared step, fixed maximum, rate-only, mixture and both fixed skills, positive two-step HT differences vs native and terminal, and at least 90 percent coverage of the registered 466 training questions with all six histories represented. Report per-dialogue, type, pivot and six-cluster bootstrap differences. Independent development and both pre-existing locked full-history tests are required for any claim about generalization.
